local p = {}
local data = mw.loadData('Module:Data/Metallic Crystals')

local function esc(value)
    return mw.text.nowiki(tostring(value or ''))
end

local function requestedRecord(frame)
    local parent = frame:getParent()
    local title = frame.args.title or frame.args[1] or (parent and (parent.args.title or parent.args[1])) or mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text
    title = mw.text.trim(title)
    local record = data.types[title]
    if not record then
        return nil, '<strong class="error">No Metallic Crystal record exists for ' .. esc(title) .. '.</strong>'
    end
    return record
end

function p.infobox(frame)
    local record, problem = requestedRecord(frame)
    if not record then return problem end
    local family = data.family
    return frame:expandTemplate {
        title = 'Infobox',
        args = {
            name = record.title,
            image = record.image,
            group1 = 'CODEX',
            label1 = 'Family', row1 = '[[Metallic Crystal]]',
            label2 = 'Category', row2 = family.codex_category,
            label3 = 'Subcategory', row3 = family.codex_subcategory,
            label4 = 'Entry ID', row4 = tostring(record.entry_id),
            group5 = 'ENCOUNTER',
            label5 = 'Encounter type', row5 = family.encounter,
            label6 = 'Scanner', row6 = family.scanner,
        }
    }
end

function p.familyInfobox(frame)
    local family = data.family
    return frame:expandTemplate {
        title = 'Infobox',
        args = {
            name = family.title,
            image = family.image,
            group1 = 'CODEX',
            label1 = 'Type', row1 = 'Organic structure',
            label2 = 'Category', row2 = family.codex_category,
            label3 = 'Subcategory', row3 = family.codex_subcategory,
            label4 = 'Known types', row4 = tostring(family.known_types),
            group5 = 'ENCOUNTER',
            label5 = 'Encounter type', row5 = family.encounter,
            label6 = 'Scanner', row6 = family.scanner,
        }
    }
end

function p.catalogue(frame)
    local out = {
        '{| class="wikitable"',
        '! Type',
        '! Codex entry ID',
    }
    for _, key in ipairs(data.order) do
        local record = data.types[key]
        local label = esc(record.title)
        if record.published and record.page then
            local page = mw.title.new(record.page)
            if page and page.exists then
                label = '[[' .. record.page .. '|' .. label .. ']]'
            end
        end
        table.insert(out, '|-')
        table.insert(out, '| ' .. label)
        table.insert(out, '| <code>' .. tostring(record.entry_id) .. '</code>')
    end
    table.insert(out, '|}')
    return frame:preprocess(table.concat(out, '\n'))
end

return p
